from qiskit.circuit import QuantumCircuit
from qiskit.primitives import StatevectorEstimator
from qiskit.quantum_info import SparsePauliOp

# Create a 2-qubit circuit
circuit = QuantumCircuit(2)
circuit.h(0)

# Create the SparsePauliOp for "XX"
obs = SparsePauliOp("XX")

# Use StatevectorEstimator to compute the expectation value
estimator = StatevectorEstimator()
job = estimator.run([(circuit, obs)])
result = job.result()

# Extract the expectation value as a float
# result[0].data.evs is a numpy array containing the expectation values
exp_val = float(result[0].data.evs)
